Name: Audit: Coherence
Protocol: Examine all structural units for logical flow, transitional clarity, and argument progression; identify coherence gaps requiring intervention.

Name: Count: Cross-References
Protocol: Count current cross-references per 10,000 words (baseline: 2-4, target: 12-20).

Name: Document: Lexical Repetition
Protocol: Document all instances of problematic repetition (e.g., forty-point-five percent appearing 8+ times).

Name: Establish: Coherence Baseline
Protocol: Establish overall coherence baseline score to measure improvement (current: 0.73).

Name: Identify: Improvement Sections
Protocol: Identify all sections requiring improvement based on coherence audit findings.

Name: Map: Implicit Discourse Relations
Protocol: Map implicit discourse relations needing explicit connectives to improve transitional clarity.

Name: Track: Connective Density
Protocol: Track current connective density across sections to establish baseline metrics.

Name: Add: Section Bridges
Protocol: Add transitional bridges between sections (e.g., 'Building on this demographic evidence' for 1.2→1.3 transition).

Name: Deploy: Additive Connectives
Protocol: Deploy additive connectives: furthermore, moreover, in addition to build cumulative arguments.

Name: Deploy: Causal Connectives
Protocol: Deploy causal connectives: therefore, consequently, as a result, thus to strengthen argument flow.

Name: Deploy: Contrastive Connectives
Protocol: Deploy contrastive connectives: nevertheless, conversely, on the other hand, yet beneath to mark contrasts.

Name: Insert: Cross-Chapter Transitions
Protocol: Insert cross-chapter transitions using connectives like 'Consequently,' 'This evidence suggests,' 'Following from this analysis.'

Name: Strengthen: Contrast Points
Protocol: Strengthen contrast points with explicit markers like 'Yet beneath' and 'However' for clarity.

Name: Add: Backward References
Protocol: Add backward references: 'As established in Section 1.4,' 'Recall from Chapter 2,' 'Building on the framework introduced in 1.4.'

Name: Add: Forward References
Protocol: Add forward references: 'As we will explore in Section X,' 'This pattern will become significant in Chapter Y.'

Name: Add: Lateral References
Protocol: Add lateral references: 'Compare this to the analysis in Section X,' 'This echoes the pattern observed in Y.'

Name: Cross-Reference: Framework Applications
Protocol: Reference void fraction framework from Chapter 1 in Chapter 2+ transitions to maintain conceptual continuity.

Name: Cross-Reference: Statistical Anchors
Protocol: Reference statistical anchors (40.5%, 406,964) consistently across sections to reinforce key findings.

Name: Link: Framework to Evidence
Protocol: Connect distributed analytical content back to core theoretical framework, reinforcing conceptual unity.

Name: Synthesize: Multiple Sections
Protocol: Create synthesis by referencing multiple earlier sections in final sections to demonstrate integration.

Name: Alternate: Family Structure Terms
Protocol: Vary 'family structure' with 'familial structure', 'household composition', 'family formation patterns', 'domestic arrangements'.

Name: Alternate: Lexical Choices
Protocol: Vary 'void fraction' with 'the framework', 'this metric', 'ε'; vary 'United States' with 'America', 'the nation'.

Name: Reduce: Verbatim Repetition
Protocol: Reduce verbatim repetition by 30-40% through strategic pronoun use and lexical variation.

Name: Replace: Repeated Noun Phrases
Protocol: Substitute pronouns for repeated institutional or actor references when antecedent is unambiguous (e.g., 'The void fraction framework... It').

Name: Replace: Technical Term Repetition
Protocol: Use 'It' for singular technical terms appearing consecutively; keep first mention as full noun phrase.

Name: Vary: Statistical References
Protocol: Reduce 'forty-point-five percent' from 8+ to 3-4 instances; vary with '40.5%', 'two-fifths', 'this rate', 'the 40.5% figure'.

Name: Ensure: Statistical Consistency
Protocol: Verify 40.5% appears with appropriate frequency; check 406,964 children figure consistency; validate $1.2-4.8T cost range usage.

Name: Validate: Reference Accuracy
Protocol: Check forward/backward references valid; ensure no broken or circular references; validate chapter/section numbering.

Name: Verify: Connective Additions
Protocol: Verify 8-12 strategic connectives added; run PDTB analysis to confirm reduced implicit relations ratio.

Name: Verify: Pronoun Clarity
Protocol: Verify no ambiguous pronoun references created; check entity grid S→S transitions improved.
